purpose: test view-consistent highlight supervision without fitting arbitrary-look HDR targets to an ACES inverse
source: Existing CC0 natural TRAIN48 and development24 parents only; preserve scene splits and each recorded render exposure
construction: Original linear AP1 reference -> declared exact ACES2 SDR view -> rounded 8-bit input. Highlight targets retain original linear reference; ordinary targets use exact inverse of clean codes bounded within 0.49 source codes; v1 shadows remain analytic. Save original linear reference separately.
build_acceptance: No train/development scene or content overlap; all target display RGB within one code of source; at least 1000 TRAIN and 100 development highlight pixels; hashes and CC0 origin evidence present
limits: Same research-used scenes, not independent holdout. Single exact ACES rendering does not establish arbitrary-look or generator generalization. Relative reference exposure, not recovered camera metadata. No change to existing benchmark or product defaults.
